name: Strixhaven
description: Strixhaven is the premier university of mages on Arcavios, founded by five elder dragons and divided into five colleges.

summary.text: Strixhaven is the premier university of mages on Arcavios, founded by five elder dragons and divided into five colleges.

bio.text: Five elder dragons found Strixhaven University, ending the Blood Age, and each consolidates the study of two mana colors into a college.
The founders include Shadrix Silverquill, Galazeth Prismari, Velomachus Lorehold, Tanazir Quandrix and Beledros Witherbloom, and founding was initially Galazeth's idea.
The Phyrexian Invasion damages Strixhaven and kills many faculty.
The year after the invasion it welcomes its first off-plane students and sets up the Path Ward to oversee Omenpaths and vet visitors.
In later stories Eula receives an invitation to the university and Quint returns by planeswalking onto its quad.

status.text: Strixhaven still operates as a university, with its most recent event showing Quint returning to its quad while it recovers from the invasion.

timeline.summary: Kasmina welcomes them to Strixhaven as they crest a ridge over the campus.
timeline.quote: Welcome to Strixhaven.

timeline.summary: Kasmina leaves them at the gates, telling them to find Mavinda Sharpbeak.
timeline.quote: Look for an owlin called Mavinda Sharpbeak.

timeline.summary: The twins find Prismari and Silverquill students dueling in a courtyard.
timeline.quote: two groups of students flung spells across a grassy field

timeline.summary: Rowan zaps a Silverquill student preparing an ink spell to protect a Prismari student.
timeline.quote: She sent a jolt of electricity at the one preparing the ink spell.

timeline.summary: A coil of living ink sweeps Rowan's feet from under her.
timeline.quote: a coil of living ink swept her feet out from under her

timeline.summary: Will's ruined Memoirs of Thadus pushes him to join the fight alongside Rowan.
timeline.quote: Maybe it is our fight.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan combine ice and lightning, but the spells fail to blend smoothly.
timeline.quote: Something wasn't right.

timeline.summary: Liliana tells Deans Lisette and Nassari she saw a masked stranger, but they dismiss the rumors.
timeline.quote: I saw a stranger in a mask on campus.

timeline.summary: The deans break up the duel, binding the students.
timeline.quote: Nassari sent a wide swath of water through the crowd, corralling Prismari students.

timeline.summary: Liliana notices the twins mention Kylem and wonders if they are planeswalkers who could be useful.
timeline.quote: They probably weren't Oriq agents.

timeline.summary: In their dorm, Will says their combined magic failed and wonders whether the plane affects it.
timeline.quote: it should have been smoother. More cohesive.

timeline.summary: Rowan leaves to live her own life, and Will resolves to find answers alone.
timeline.quote: We may be twins, but I'm allowed to live my own life.

timeline.summary: Kasmina watches the twins through her owl's eyes.
timeline.quote: She could still see the twins in her mind, their images a bit warped from the shape of those avian eyes.

timeline.summary: Liliana visits the dragon Beledros's empty lair in search of arcane writings.
timeline.quote: She had neither as she approached the tangled grove where Beledros Witherbloom made her home.

timeline.summary: Liliana asks Beledros how aetheric reincorporation could work on humans, holding a tip of Gideon's sural blade.
timeline.quote: What would it take for such methods to work on humans?

timeline.summary: Liliana begs Beledros to help give Gideon back his life.
timeline.quote: He took my death. Help me give him back his life.

timeline.summary: Beledros refuses to help.
timeline.quote: I cannot.

timeline.summary: Beledros tells Liliana that how we honor the dead is reflected in how we treat the living.
timeline.quote: how we honor the dead is reflected in how we treat the living

timeline.summary: Extus decides the Snarl beneath the school could give him the power he needs.
timeline.quote: that overlapping tangle of power hidden away below the school would offer more than enough

timeline.summary: Liliana abandons her fruitless search for a way to revive Gideon and reflects on destiny.
timeline.quote: There wasn't a book or scroll or spell in Strixhaven that could bring Gideon back.

timeline.summary: Liliana sees Rowan Kenrith with friends and decides to take her professor role more seriously.
timeline.quote: Maybe it's time to take my role as a Professor a little more seriously.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan argue about her lack of study, and lightning sparks from her hair when she gets angry.
timeline.quote: it was the coils of electricity jumping between loose strands of hair on his sister's face

timeline.summary: The twins stop speaking for weeks until the Mage Tower match.
timeline.quote: he hadn't spoken to her in weeks

timeline.summary: A Prismari player hypnotizes the Silverquill mascot into biting its holder and steals it in the Mage Tower match.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, it leaned over and sunk two long liquid fangs into the Silverquill player's hand.

timeline.summary: Will provokes Rowan in the stands, and she shocks him with lightning.
timeline.quote: Will felt the spark jump from her outstretched hand and pass through his whole body in an instant.

timeline.summary: Will freezes Rowan's boots and hand with his ice magic.
timeline.quote: Rowan gasped as a rime of frost suddenly solidified around her boots, freezing her feet in place.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx stops the fight and takes the twins to her office.
timeline.quote: He squinted as he looked up, meeting Professor Onyx's gaze.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx warns the twins about the Oriq and hints Strixhaven does not hold all power on the plane, leaving Will suspecting she is a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Strixhaven doesn't have a monopoly on power in this plane.

timeline.summary: Will wants to prepare to defend the students, while Rowan says she will prepare her own way.
timeline.quote: I'll prepare my own way for whatever's coming.

timeline.summary: Kasmina watches Rowan practice lightning through her owl.
timeline.quote: Below, she could see the Kenrith girl sending forked lightning across the lawn.

timeline.summary: Kasmina's owl sees a masked Oriq agent offer Lukka a silver skull mask, which he refuses.
timeline.quote: It was a silver mask, shaped like a human skull.

timeline.summary: Auvernine siphons the life force of a saltgobbler into a potion.
timeline.quote: Rowan's hand went to her mouth as she watched the creature's life force flow through the air and into her friend's potion.

timeline.summary: Kasmina confronts Lukka at the edge of the courtyard and he refuses to be anyone's pawn.
timeline.quote: It's a shame to see a man like you fallen so far.

timeline.summary: Kasmina and Lukka fight with wind and blade.
timeline.quote: Kasmina sent a scythe of pressurized air straight at Lukka's chest.

timeline.summary: Kasmina warns Lukka that Extus fights only for himself.
timeline.quote: Do you think Extus is going to change all that?

timeline.summary: Kasmina pins Lukka with her staff and demands he yield.
timeline.quote: Before he could get up, Kasmina was there, the point of her staff held just under his chin.

timeline.summary: A swarm of mage hunters approaches the school, and Lukka says they are just getting started.
timeline.quote: a swarm of chitinous, chittering forms scurried between the trees

timeline.summary: Kasmina flees in a cloud of white feathers.
timeline.quote: a cloud of white feathers whipped over her, and she was gone

timeline.summary: Extus orders the Oriq to attack as Lukka controls the mage hunters.
timeline.quote: Commence the attack.

timeline.summary: Dina finds an esis seedling in Professor Onyx's classroom and takes a root sliver for the ritual.
timeline.quote: Among them was a single seedling whose ghostly white leaves matched that of the esis tree.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx grades exams and recalls her strict mentor Lady Ana.
timeline.quote: Professor Serafina Onyx blew air at the flame, causing it to dance.

timeline.summary: Lisette returns the chained tome to Onyx, furious.
timeline.quote: I believe this is yours

timeline.summary: Lisette threatens to remove Onyx from the school, and Onyx says it can be arranged.
timeline.quote: And I'll die before I stop trying to get you as far away from this school as I can.

timeline.summary: Onyx traces the esis leaf and the tome rots away, leaving only its chains.
timeline.quote: A black rot spread outward from where she touched it, consuming all the pages in the book, leaving nothing but the chains that had bound them.

timeline.summary: Will wakes to learn from Wickel that the Oriq are attacking.
timeline.quote: The Oriq are here

timeline.summary: Wickel raises a wall of earth to hold back mage hunters while students flee.
timeline.quote: A semicircle of churning soil rippled out from where he stood, rising up into a wall of dense earth between the creatures and the students.

timeline.summary: Rowan, Plink and Auvernine fight mage hunters at the Witherbloom dormitories.
timeline.quote: Rowan howled and swung her sword.

timeline.summary: Rowan decides to head for the Biblioplex, where she expects Will to be.
timeline.quote: If she knew her brother, that's where he would be.

timeline.summary: Liliana reflects an Oriq life-draining spell back onto its caster, killing him.
timeline.quote: With a gesture, Liliana sent it racing back toward the caster, twice as hungry as before.

timeline.summary: Dean Kianne spears a mage hunter with a lance of force.
timeline.quote: Kianne sent a geometric lance of force piercing through it.

timeline.summary: Liliana spots a man in a red uniform with mandible-like features who commands the mage hunters.
timeline.quote: He locked eyes with her, and with eerie coordination, all of the other mage hunters surged toward them.

timeline.summary: Liliana realizes the campus-wide attack is a distraction.
timeline.quote: An attack all across the campus, with no apparent aim but destruction and chaos.

timeline.summary: Will freezes dew to trip a mage hunter and drains heat from another's shell.
timeline.quote: Behind him, the evening dew condensed into hard ice.

timeline.summary: The dragons arrive and burn the mage hunters to ash with columns of fire.
timeline.quote: A column of fire shot down from the sky and swept over the ground.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan reunite and hug.
timeline.quote: They ran toward each other and fell into a hug, squeezing each other tightly.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx kills an Oriq agent aiming at the twins.
timeline.quote: When she opened them, she saw the Oriq splayed across the ground.

timeline.summary: Onyx admits she is not a responsible professor and recruits the twins to help her.
timeline.quote: No. I'm not quite so responsible as that. And I need help.

timeline.summary: Onyx opens an old maintenance passage she found as a student.
timeline.quote: It's an old maintenance passage I found when I was a student.

timeline.summary: Onyx explains Extus leads the Oriq and is responsible for the attack.
timeline.quote: The man responsible for all of this. The leader of the Oriq.

timeline.summary: Will saves Rowan from falling through a rotting bridge.
timeline.quote: Will dove as Rowan fell, locking one hand around her wrist.

timeline.summary: Onyx reveals she is leading them to where the most damage could be done.
timeline.quote: I'm taking you where I would go, if I wanted to cause the most damage possible.

timeline.summary: The twins zap and ice-bind Oriq agents as Liliana leads them to the Snarl.
timeline.quote: at the first sign of one of the masked Oriq, Rowan would zap them with a current of energy that left them twitching on the ground

timeline.summary: Across campus, Lukka feels the roar while controlling the mage hunters and tells Mila that Extus got what he wanted.
timeline.quote: It found Lukka, even through the concentration it took from him to keep all the mage hunters fighting on several fronts.

timeline.summary: Dragonfire kills nearby mage hunters, and Lukka severs the link to avoid being overwhelmed.
timeline.quote: he severed the link before he could be overwhelmed

timeline.summary: Freed mage hunters turn on the nearest Oriq agents.
timeline.quote: turned on the nearest source of magical sustenance: Oriq agents

timeline.summary: Lukka decides this is no longer his fight and flees with Mila.
timeline.quote: Calling Mila to his side, Lukka turned and ran into the dark.

timeline.summary: Five weeks later Will refuses a living wood leg and uses an ice-and-steel prosthesis.
timeline.quote: He had refused the offers from Dean Lisette of a living wood replacement.

timeline.summary: Will insists they should stay and study because they beat the Avatar with a spell learned at Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: We took down a Blood Avatar with a spell that we learned here

timeline.summary: Rowan, noticeably thinner, tells Will she loves him.
timeline.quote: You know I love you, right?

timeline.summary: Kasmina surveys the restored campus and the memorial statue.
timeline.quote: The damage from the attack was all but erased; cobbles replaced, hedges regrown.

timeline.summary: Kasmina sees Lukka wandering with Mila and remaining Oriq, but turns her attention to the twins.
timeline.quote: But he was no longer worth watching.

timeline.summary: Liliana returns to Strixhaven and the deans invite her to remain a professor indefinitely.
timeline.quote: they had invited her to remain a professor at the university indefinitely

timeline.summary: Liliana puts away her research journals, parting from her old friend.
timeline.quote: It seems this is where we finally part, old friend.

timeline.summary: Liliana introduces herself to her class as Professor Liliana Vess.
timeline.quote: My name is Professor Liliana Vess.

timeline.summary: Zimone recalls Dean Kianne urging her to consider Quandrix.
timeline.quote: Please tell me you are considering Quandrix College for next year.

timeline.summary: On her seventh birthday, Zimone received her first box of eight blue-green ribbons from her grandmother (flashback).
timeline.quote: Inside the velveteen-lined box were eight green-and-blue-striped ribbons and a note

timeline.summary: Zimone learns pieces of the story that her grandmother left Strixhaven after forgetting things and was never seen again (flashback).
timeline.quote: that she left Strixhaven and was never seen again

timeline.summary: Silverquill wins the Mage Tower game after hypnotizing Quandrix's captain.
timeline.quote: Silverquill College won even though one of their players hypnotized Quandrix College's captain at the finals.

timeline.summary: Zimone counts 377 ribbons and reads that this will be the last package.
timeline.quote: So, this will be the last one.

timeline.summary: Dean Imbraham teaches theory to second-year Quandrix mages.
timeline.quote: The most important thing you have to know about theory is that it is just substance we haven't figured out yet

timeline.summary: Imbraham tells Zimone she looks like her grandmother, whom he once taught.
timeline.quote: Your grandmother, Nimiroti Wola. Taught her in this same class many years ago.

timeline.summary: Imbraham praises Nimiroti as the best student he ever taught.
timeline.quote: The best student I've ever taught.

timeline.summary: Kianne tells Zimone her name is who she is.
timeline.quote: At this point, Zimone Wola is more than your name.

timeline.summary: Zimone dreams of the Arithmodrome crumbling as she tries to save a woman braiding ribbons.
timeline.quote: Zimone races toward her to save her, because the Arithmodrome is crumbling.

timeline.summary: Kianne suspects Zimone and Imbraham of pursuing the Vorzani Conjecture and Zimone resists.
timeline.quote: Fear that I will find out what you and Dean Imbraham have been up to.

timeline.summary: Kianne says Imbraham egged Nimiroti on until the Oriq got hold of her.
timeline.quote: egged her on until the Oriq got hold of her

timeline.summary: Zimone wakes to find Extus and Pita, who introduce themselves.
timeline.quote: My name is Extus

timeline.summary: Extus says they have followed Zimone for years and know about the packages.
timeline.quote: We have followed you for years.

timeline.summary: Extus offers to share what the Oriq knows about the Conjecture to control the universe.
timeline.quote: And we'll tell you what we know, and together, we can control the universe.

timeline.summary: Zimone refuses and lashes Extus and Pita into a wall with the ribbon braid.
timeline.quote: whips the braid of blue-green ribbons at the two men, sending them crashing into the wall at the far end of the room

timeline.summary: Pita argues Strixhaven hoards magic and that destroying it would spread magic to all.
timeline.quote: If we destroy it, then anyone anywhere in the world can practice magic.

timeline.summary: Dean Kianne bursts in with Amaka and Nnanyielugo.
timeline.quote: Get away from her!

timeline.summary: Kianne redirects Extus's fireball, and Zimone stops and douses it with her braid.
timeline.quote: Zimone swirls the braid of blue-green ribbons, weaving it into the tiny cracks of time and space

timeline.summary: Extus departs, saying they will meet again.
timeline.quote: Though I trust we'll meet again, Zimone Wola.

timeline.summary: Rumors spread that Zimone is an Oriq recruit and her friends avoid her.
timeline.quote: somehow, the rumor of her being an Oriq recruit spread around Strixhaven

timeline.summary: Dean Shaile tells Killian in the infirmary that he must embrace the light.
timeline.quote: You must learn to embrace the light every now and again.

timeline.summary: Shaile warns him not to spend all his magic in one place.
timeline.quote: Don't spend all your magic in one place.

timeline.summary: Killian leaps onto a boat to meet his father using a water-solidifying spell.
timeline.quote: Killian spoke the spell aloud as he soared through the air

timeline.summary: Fannessa teases Killian on the boat and talks of light magic.
timeline.quote: So that's how the great Killian Lu is never late for anything

timeline.summary: Fannessa suggests a Bow's End elixir for his sore throat.
timeline.quote: I might know a girl who knows a guy at Bow's End that can whip one up no problem.

timeline.summary: Fannessa urges Killian to step out of the shadows and leaves on a boat to Bow's End.
timeline.quote: You should step out in the sun once in a while, Killian Lu

timeline.summary: Killian's signed light blinds and immobilizes the mage hunters.
timeline.quote: Killian's spells flowed like water down their backs and along their tails, where it consumed their termini, immobilizing them.

timeline.summary: Students led by Dina blast the mage hunters to pieces.
timeline.quote: The final attack came from Dina, who hurled an enormous ball of pulsing beryl magic at the horrid creatures and shattered them into pieces.

timeline.summary: Vickus says Killian's light has created a way to turn the Oriq toward the light.
timeline.quote: You've created a way to bring them to the light.

timeline.summary: Embrose, Shaile and Razineth watch with the crowd as Killian wins the day.
timeline.quote: Embrose, arms folded and face stern, was standing amid the crowd

timeline.summary: Embrose shows a faint sign of approval, and patriscrit on Killian's palm declares he can create.
timeline.quote: it was what one might consider the beginnings of a smile, a sign of mild approval

timeline.summary: Liliana, a professor at Strixhaven, is visited in a dream by the Raven Man, who calls her to come home.
timeline.quote: "Come home , my Lili.

timeline.summary: Quint and four students search the tunnels beneath Strixhaven for the Invocation of the Founders.
timeline.quote: I wonder if the invocation will really slow the Phyrexian invasion, like Professor Vess said.

timeline.summary: Quint summons the spirit of Dean Herrian the Second from a statue, who reveals they are directly under the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: How can you be lost when you're under the Biblioplex?

timeline.summary: The students read the five petals of the invocation on the roof, describing Strixhaven's nature back to itself.
timeline.quote: They told Strixhaven what it was, and in that telling, there was no room for Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Dean Nassari shatters Rootha's ice wall and attacks her, making her petal go dark and the invocation fail.
timeline.quote: The invocation was failing

timeline.summary: Quint grabs Rootha's petal and pours his life into the invocation to complete it.
timeline.quote: he powered the invocation with his life alone

timeline.summary: A light erupts from Quint, wrecking the Biblioplex and Dean Nassari, closing the portals and swallowing Quint.
timeline.quote: Dean Nassari was flung from the rooftop

timeline.summary: The students emerge from the dormitory to ruin, with Liliana directing survivors and tending the wounded.
timeline.quote: but ruin

timeline.summary: Liliana raises an undead army to hold the ruins against the returning Phyrexian portals.
timeline.quote: Skeletons and zombies erupted from the ground

timeline.summary: Zimone, Tyvar and Niko go to Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: The others had gone with Zimone back to Strixhaven

timeline.summary: Ajani arrives at Liliana's office at Strixhaven; she guesses someone has died.
timeline.quote: Who died?

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Liliana that Jace has died.
timeline.quote: It was such a small word.

timeline.summary: Ajani reveals that Jace had let Bolas be captured by Ugin and then Bolas escaped through an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: So Bolas escaped.

timeline.summary: Liliana's teacup shatters as she absorbs the news.
timeline.quote: Her teacup shattered as it hit the floor.

timeline.summary: Dina bursts in to report that four students are missing after following a flying creature down an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: We think they fell down an Omenpath, but it closed before we could go after them.

timeline.summary: Ajani offers to try to find the missing students and goes with Dina to the site.
timeline.quote: I can certainly try,

timeline.summary: Liliana scolds Tam and says she will not ask Ajani for another favor, calling Oko a bastard.
timeline.quote: Encounters with that bastard Oko rarely end that well for anyone but him.

timeline.summary: A white-clad woman with Liliana's own face arrives at Liliana's office and asks her to close the door for a conversation.
timeline.quote: Maybe close the door, dear. We need to have a conversation.

timeline.summary: Jilesa and Esmun go to interview the new instructor Professor Zarek for a puff piece in the Star.
timeline.quote: Reporter from the Strixhaven Star , here for the interview.

timeline.summary: In his office Jilesa casts a hidden interrogation spell on Zarek, who breaks it and instead offers her a secret project.
timeline.quote: Professor Zarek smoothed his hair with one hand, then snapped his fingers above his head.

timeline.summary: Zarek reveals he is searching for a Blood Age tome about the birth of the elder dragons and that Ravnica's leylines may be destabilized by him.
timeline.quote: I think the leylines of Ravnica may have been destabilized by … well, me.

timeline.summary: Jilesa suggests asking the Codex Vocifera, and the three go to find it.
timeline.quote: Don't just sit there, you two. We've got a codex to catch.

timeline.summary: Zarek learns the vault passcode and sets off alone, but Jilesa insists on joining and he relents.
timeline.quote: Your skills would be very useful. Are you sure you're up to the challenge?

timeline.summary: The Blood Age ends when five elder dragons found Strixhaven University.
timeline.quote: It was only when five mighty elder dragons came together and founded Strixhaven University that the Blood Age finally came to an end

timeline.summary: Each Founder Dragon consolidates the study of two mana colors into a college, and mages become the most powerful force.
timeline.quote: Each dragon consolidated the study of its two mana colors into a magical college

timeline.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion damages Strixhaven and kills many faculty.
timeline.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion, much of the university campus was damaged or destroyed, and a significant number of faculty lost their lives.

timeline.summary: Strixhaven welcomes its first off-plane students the year after the invasion.
timeline.quote: The inaugural class of off-plane students was welcomed at Strixhaven the year after the invasion

timeline.summary: Strixhaven establishes the Path Ward to oversee Omenpaths and vet visitors.
timeline.quote: the university has established the Path Ward, a committee to oversee the Omenpaths.

timeline.summary: Lluwen writes about feeling isolated among Arcavian elves and plans to join the Witherbloom trip to Titan's Grave.
timeline.quote: There's a Witherbloom trip to Titan's Grave in the works right now.

timeline.summary: Abigale recalls Professor Fel's poisonous-flora class, which made her drop it.
timeline.quote: I dropped out of the class that day.

timeline.summary: Tam recounts meeting Fel at night and decides he is worth working with; she offers to accompany Lluwen.
timeline.quote: Lluwen, if it would help you to have company, I don't mind coming along at all.

timeline.summary: Lluwen describes his admission interview with Fel, who stamps his form anyway.
timeline.quote: But he stamped my form anyway.

timeline.summary: Kirol sees the Code Oona message and sets out to help, but runs into Ajani.
timeline.quote: When the five of them had come up with the phrase

timeline.summary: Kirol tells Ajani an archaic carried Jadzi away and Fel is acting strangely; Ajani offers a compromise.
timeline.quote: Let me speak with the other professors and see what I can learn.

timeline.summary: Kirol requisitions a horse and leaves before Ajani returns.
timeline.quote: From atop a requisitioned horse, Kirol grinned back at the camp.

timeline.summary: In a place that is not quite Strixhaven, Tam stands over the sleeping Jadzi and is comforted by a man in white, who promises she will meet others like her.
timeline.quote: "You've found the others?" she asked him.

timeline.summary: Eula learns the letter is an invitation to Strixhaven on Arcavios with tuition and supplies covered and an omenpath ticket.
timeline.quote: "A place called Strixhaven, on a plane called Arcavios. They teach wizards there."

timeline.summary: Quint returns to Arcavios by planeswalking onto the Strixhaven quad and heads for the Lorehold campus.
timeline.quote: In a flash of warm, radiant light and the sound of rustling paper, a loxodon appeared.

timeline.summary: Quint tells Dean Tullus's secretary that reports of his death were exaggerated and asks to see the dean.
timeline.quote: "Reports of my death or vaporization have been highly exaggerated

timeline.summary: Quint explains his search for a coin motif spanning planes, and Dean Tullus listens.
timeline.quote: the strange coin motif he had encountered there

timeline.summary: Quint reveals the Coin Empire vanished overnight and may have left something behind on Arcavios.
timeline.quote: Functionally overnight, they were gone.

timeline.summary: Quint persuades Dean Tullus to hire him as a temporary teaching assistant so he can join the Fields of Strife excursion.
timeline.quote: "No. I'm suggesting you hire me as a temporary teaching assistant.

timeline.summary: Flashback: after Duskmourn Zimone returns to Strixhaven with Niko and Tyvar to report to Dean Nev.
timeline.quote: After Duskmourn, Zimone returned to Strixhaven.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Dean Nev says the Firemind does not recommend further study of Duskmourn's spread, and Zimone panics.
timeline.quote: the Firemind does not recommend pursuing study at the moment.

timeline.summary: Ennis bests professors in debate and is urged to lead the debate club.
timeline.quote: After he bested a number of exasperated professors in arguments

timeline.summary: During the invasion Killian focuses on bolstering his allies.
timeline.quote: During the invasion, Killian knew his magic could not overpower the Phyrexians alone, and he focused on bolstering his allies.

timeline.summary: Zaffai forms the Tempests with graduate students to stage an atmospheric display at Summitfest.
timeline.quote: he and a number of his most daring graduate students have formed the Tempests

timeline.summary: Galazeth founds Strixhaven with an idea and is first to leave it to its own devices.
timeline.quote: The founding of Strixhaven was initially Galazeth's idea, yet he was also the first to leave the university to its own devices.

timeline.summary: Rootha fixates on her perceived failures in the Invocation of the Founders and delays her graduation.
timeline.quote: Rootha has delayed her graduation, unable to finish the thesis she has lingered on for years.

timeline.summary: Kirol decides exploring and preserving history is more important after the invasion's losses.
timeline.quote: after the losses of the Phyrexian Invasion, they felt that exploring and preserving history was more important than ever

timeline.summary: Lluwen betrays his superiors in Lorwyn to help Strixhaven students and then joins them as a student.
timeline.quote: Most recently, he betrayed his superiors in Lorwyn to help a group of Strixhaven students

timeline.summary: Augusta prepares a ritual so she can be summoned after her death and returns as a spirit after dying in the invasion.
timeline.quote: despite her death in the Phyrexian Invasion, her spirit still serves as the interim dean of order

timeline.summary: Nev and Adrix are appointed Quandrix deans after the deaths of Kianne and Imbraham.
timeline.quote: After the deaths of Kianne and Imbraham, the two were appointed as deans of Quandrix

timeline.summary: Zimone graduates from Quandrix and begins a fellowship on Ravnica.
timeline.quote: graduated from Quandrix and has begun a new fellowship on Ravnica

timeline.summary: Zimone summons Primo, then refuses to unsummon him after returning from Duskmourn.
timeline.quote: she found herself unwilling to unsummon him

timeline.summary: Moseo is nearly compleated, excises the Phyrexian influence and is left as a skeleton.
timeline.quote: was nearly compleated during the Phyrexian Invasion

timeline.summary: Moseo replaces the deceased Valentin as dean of the vein.
timeline.quote: Moseo willingly stepped up to replace the deceased Valentin as the new dean of the vein.

timeline.summary: Blex is killed in the invasion and, soon after, a lookalike, Blech, appears.
